summary: Iteration 92 — Verified reversion to real photos on /courses + landing hero product-stage, plus new admin photo-upload feature. Landing hero shows real Unsplash/Pexels photos on all 3 tabs (interview/model/document) with fade transition; tab clicks pause auto-rotate correctly. /courses shows 1 real Equity Research Analyst card with a real photo thumbnail (Unsplash category fallback since image_url column is still pending migration), pagination shows '1', stats strip + closing CTA render cleanly. Admin > Courses tab shows the 64x64 thumbnail button, hidden file input, and Preview & Free Sessions button per row; photo upload triggers a clean 503 with an easy-to-read migration hint (exactly the expected behavior). Backend GET /api/admin/courses correctly falls back to id/title/description select and returns media_ready=false + hint field without a 500.
critical_code_review_comments: wave_endpoints.py is 4600+ lines — consider splitting into per-feature modules for maintainability (not new to this iteration).

HeroProductShowcase uses external image CDNs (Unsplash/Pexels) directly — a network hiccup can cause a brief blank photo on the first tab paint (observed once during testing). Consider self-hosting or adding an onError fallback per image.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Migration 0046_courses_media.sql is still pending. Once run in Supabase, the 5 'Coming Soon' seeded course rows should appear on /courses, and admin photo uploads should succeed (200 + public URL). At that point, retest: (a) /courses shows 6 total cards with 1 Live + 5 Coming Soon, (b) admin photo upload succeeds and the returned image_url renders on both admin thumbnail and /courses card.

verified_behavior.landing_hero_photos: All 3 tabs render real photos (Unsplash/Pexels) with fade transitions; auto-rotate pauses after manual tab click.
verified_behavior.courses_page: 1 real card visible, pagination shows '1', stats + closing CTA render.
verified_behavior.admin_courses_tab: Thumbnail button, hidden file input (course-photo-input-<id>), title edit, and Preview & Free Sessions button all present and functional. Photo upload returns clean 503 alert: 'Photo upload failed: The master_paths.image_url/category/is_coming_soon columns aren\'t present yet. Run /app/scripts/migrations/0046_courses_media.sql in the Supabase SQL editor.'
verified_behavior.GET_admin_courses: Returns 200 with graceful fallback (media_ready=false + hint) — no 500.
